name: fullstack-backend
description: 订单/库存领域后端，Node + Express + TypeScript，配套 fullstack-handbook 的深挖章节

scripts.test: tsx --test apps/api/test/api.test.ts apps/api/test/products.test.ts apps/api/test/foreign-key.test.ts apps/api/test/money.test.ts apps/api/test/migrate.test.ts apps/api/test/expand.test.ts apps/api/test/orders.test.ts apps/api/test/transaction.test.ts
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run check:encoding && npm run test
scripts.db:reset: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('apps/api/data',{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('数据库已清空，下次启动 api 会重建')"
